entities.name: ʻAlī ibn Muḥammad Madāʼinī
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi Sayf al-Qurashi, commonly known by his nisba al-Mada'ini, was a scholar of Iranian descent who wrote in Arabic and was active under the early Abbasids in Iraq in the first half of the 9th century. A scholar of many interests, he wrote over 200 works, but is best known as a historian.
